Frequency of a term over time

Source: R/text.R
parl_trend.Rd

Counts the occurrences of pattern by month or year (and optionally by party or by government/opposition) and divides them by the number of words spoken in that period, giving a rate per million words. Periods without sessions are kept with paraules = 0 and rate = NA (for example, the suspension of the Parliament, October 1934 - February 1936).

Usage

parl_trend(
  pattern,
  by = c("month", "year"),
  group = c("none", "party", "side"),
  per = 1e+06,
  ...,
  regex = FALSE,
  ignore_case = TRUE,
  ignore_accents = TRUE
)

Arguments

pattern

Character. A word or phrase, or a regular expression when regex = TRUE.

by

"month" (default) or "year".

group

"none" (default), "party" (party_data) or "side" (government/opposition).

per

Numeric. Rate denominator (default one million words).

...

Filters passed to parl_speeches() (year, party, person...).

regex

Logical. Treat pattern as a regular expression (ICU syntax).

ignore_case

Logical. Case-insensitive search (default TRUE).

ignore_accents

Logical. Accent-insensitive search (default TRUE), useful with OCR and period spellings.

Value

A tibble with periode, grup, n_matches, n_speeches (speeches with at least one match), paraules and rate.

Examples

old <- parl_use_sample()
parl_trend("Govern", by = "year")
#> # A tibble: 7 × 6
#>   periode grup  n_matches n_speeches paraules  rate
#>   <chr>   <chr>     <dbl>      <dbl>    <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 1932    all           0          0   189773   0  
#> 2 1933    all          29         17  2684097  10.8
#> 3 1934    all           0          0   917809   0  
#> 4 1935    all           0          0        0  NA  
#> 5 1936    all           0          0   660926   0  
#> 6 1937    all           0          0    38389   0  
#> 7 1938    all           0          0    27467   0  
parl_use_sample(old)
